signature_moves: Document-hero title: each list opens with an oversized black-weight display heading dwarfing all chrome (magazine/editorial hierarchy reframes a to-do list as a document)
Emoji as taxonomy in the sidebar (Notion-borrowed recognition anchors instead of SF Symbols)

Non-native tells (corrections, not defects for a web app): custom typeface->SF Pro; circular checkbox->square NSButton; app-defined accent->system accent; tinted #232233 canvas->neutral #1E1E1E; in-app <> nav->real toolbar w/ menu-bar parity

aesthetic.direction: expressive editorial productivity — desaturated indigo-navy dark canvas, oversized custom-type display headings, emoji taxonomy, one warm brand accent; committed brand system, not template-default
aesthetic.cluster_hint: editorial-nocturnal web-productivity (NON-NATIVE cluster; keep separate from macOS native canon)

psychology: Von Restorff (isolation) — lone warm red brand mark pops against an all-cool palette; oversized hero title isolates the current document
Aesthetic-Usability Effect — high structural polish and coherent hierarchy raise perceived usability
Jakob's Law — breadcrumb, checklists, and history nav borrow web-productivity conventions users already know
Recognition over recall (Nielsen) — emoji per sidebar item give fast visual scanning anchors
Hick's Law — quiet chrome, no competing saturated CTAs, keeps choice load low
notes: ONLY asset is a marketing cover composite (1200x630 OG image): purple brand backdrop + wordmark + icon, an angled iPhone render (iOS 'Inbox' audio-transcription screen, contrast-only), and a flat desktop window (the real evidence). Render is at unknown zoom, so absolute pt is unrecoverable — type tokens are ratios + hex, px marked estimated. Lineage is web-electron (Superlist is a cross-platform web-stack app): profile it but it feeds a non-native cluster and tells-and-corrections, NEVER macOS canon. Traffic lights / real titlebar are covered by the phone, so native chrome could not be confirmed. Icon (converted from AVIF) is a Big-Sur-era warm red-orange squircle with a curling folded-page 'S' — noted as brand evidence; no icon digest written (Workflow A only).
